title: The local ring of the fibre ring at a prime is the quotient of the local ring
statement: Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, $\mathfrak p\subset A$ a prime ideal with residue field $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=A_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak pA_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], $C=B\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ the fibre ring and $j:B\to C$, $b\mapsto b\otimes1$. Let $\mathfrak Q\subset C$ be a prime ideal and $\mathfrak q=j^{-1}(\mathfrak Q)$, a prime ideal of $B$; let $B_{\mathfrak q}$ and $C_{\mathfrak Q}$ be the localizations [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] and $\mathfrak pB_{\mathfrak q}$ the ideal of $B_{\mathfrak q}$ generated by the elements $\varphi(a)/1$, $a\in\mathfrak p$. Then there is an isomorphism of rings $C_{\mathfrak Q}\cong B_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak pB_{\mathfrak q}$.
